title: Ride-Hailing Fraud Detection
scenario: Detect 'Rapid Cycling' fraud: Find drivers who completed more than 5 trips in under 1 hour in a single day.
tableSchema: trips (driver_id INT, pickup_time TIMESTAMP, dropoff_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Self-join or use window frame range to count trips in 1-hour window.
correctQuery: SELECT driver_id, pickup_time::DATE FROM (SELECT driver_id, pickup_time, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY driver_id ORDER BY pickup_time RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND INTERVAL '1 hour' FOLLOWING) as trip_count FROM trips) t WHERE trip_count > 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (driver_id INT, pickup_time TIMESTAMP, dropoff_time TIMESTAMP);
